title: Paper v2 MiniQMT route inherits forbidden StrategyPackage QE backtest contract before MiniQMT execution authority
description:
Expected: Paper v2 broker_backend=minqmt_sim should not inherit or validate HMM, ST PIT, ordinary runtime profile, or execution-policy changes from the StrategyPackage QE backtest runtime contract before entering MiniQMT execution. MiniQMT should be the broker/execution authority for acceptance, fills, cash, positions, and order status, while HMM/ST PIT remain platform runtime functions and ordinary configuration changes use auditable package/runtime versions or activations. The route must be explicitly verified for HMM disabled, new platform HMM snapshot, platform ST PIT data, and a versioned execution-policy activation.
Actual: The miniQMT UI creates an ordinary Paper v2 portfolio with data_source=MINIQMT_REALTIME and broker_backend=minqmt_sim, but the backend still runs the common Paper v2 StrategyPackage/QE backtest contract path before the minqmt_sim branch. create_portfolio resolves execution policy through validate_execution_policy_matches_manifest(); readiness and day_runner call normalize_runtime_config_with_backtest_contract(), validate_execution_policy_matches_manifest(), and validate_runtime_profile_matches_backtest_contract() before branching into minqmt_sim handling. Therefore a miniQMT Paper v2 run can still be blocked by the same forbidden HMM/ST PIT/execution-policy binding defects even though current miniQMT testing may not have reached this layer yet.
required_verification: Regression test: broker_backend=minqmt_sim with runtime_profile.hmm.enabled=false preserves HMM disabled through readiness and day_runner and does not re-inject StrategyPackage QE HMM fields.
Regression test: broker_backend=minqmt_sim can use a newly trained platform HMM snapshot when coefficients cover the trade date, without matching the StrategyPackage QE backtest snapshot.
Regression test: broker_backend=minqmt_sim consumes platform ST PIT/risk data and does not require a ST PIT/risk_policy snapshot embedded in StrategyPackage backtest custom_params.

Regression test: broker_backend=minqmt_sim can activate and run a different validated execution-policy version through Paper v2 activation history, while rejecting raw ad-hoc runtime_config execution overrides.
Integration test: MiniQMT-specific authority branch is reached only after runtime/platform checks that comply with the product rule; no forbidden QE backtest contract gate remains on the path.
Coverage check: existing miniQMT adapter tests are extended beyond broker/data-source matching to exercise Paper v2 readiness/day_runner with HMM/ST PIT/execution-policy versioning inputs.
closure_requirements: Paper v2 miniQMT portfolios no longer fail or silently override runtime settings because of StrategyPackage QE HMM/ST PIT/runtime contract state.
The minqmt_sim route uses MiniQMT for execution authority while using current platform HMM/ST PIT services, not StrategyPackage-bound platform data.
The fix is linked with BUG-065/#76, BUG-066/#77, BUG-071/#84, and BUG-072/#85, and all five closure suites pass together.
No production backend 8001, frontend 3000, or production DB is used as the proof path unless explicitly approved.

events.note: Registered from direct read-only miniQMT route scan; no runtime code changed.

Reason for separate issue: BUG-072 covers generic execution-policy activation, but this issue makes the miniQMT route-specific blocker explicit so current miniQMT repair work cannot declare readiness without exercising this path.

Code evidence: minqmt_sim branching in readiness.py/day_runner.py happens after normalize_runtime_config_with_backtest_contract, validate_execution_policy_matches_manifest, and validate_runtime_profile_matches_backtest_contract.

qmt_strategy_ledger virtual-strategy route did not directly call the backtest_contract validators in read-only scan, but it can still be indirectly polluted by a Selection Center selection_run produced under the forbidden contract.
